Before you start

Ultra Talking Pulse uses your front camera to estimate your pulse and breathing rate.

• The camera is on only while a measurement is running, and only after you press Start.
• Video is processed on this phone by the Presage SmartSpectra SDK. Ultra Talking Pulse never records, saves or uploads video or images.
• Results are shown on screen only. They are not saved and disappear when you close the app.
• The app connects to Presage's servers to verify its API key and count usage. The SDK's optional anonymous usage statistics are turned off.
• Measure only yourself, or someone who has agreed to it.
• This is not a medical device. Do not use it for diagnosis or treatment.

You can read this again or withdraw your consent at any time from the Privacy and consent button.
